instruction: Change the Chrome browser language to Spanish (es).

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing Chrome language to Spanish. Uses existing get_chrome_language getter which reads the app_locale from Chrome Local State preferences. Accepts various Spanish locale codes (Spain, Mexico, Argentina). Verified with match_in_list metric.
metadata.verification: Uses existing Chrome language getter. Same complexity as original - navigate to Chrome settings and change language preference. Default is 'en-US'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Chrome language setting from Local State preferences file (intl.app_locale field)
Metric correctly verifies result is in the list of acceptable Spanish locale codes
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure language changes are persisted to disk
Expected values comprehensively cover Spanish variants (es, es-ES, es-MX, es-AR)
Evaluation logic will correctly verify that Chrome language was changed to Spanish
All instruction requirements are covered by the evaluator
